title: Security Deposits Amount Schedule: Basis Bill, Multiple, Estimates, Floor, Ceiling and Rounding
content:
The figures below are the amount terms of each Security Deposits tier. They state which monthly bill a deposit is a multiple of, how many billing periods are looked at, the estimate used when a location has too little history, and the floor, ceiling and rounding step of the tier.

## Terms defined

- **Basis bill**: the average monthly bill over the lookback, or the highest monthly bill in the lookback, as the tier states.
- **Deposit multiple**: the number of basis bills that sets the deposit.
- **Bill lookback**: the billing periods immediately before the assessment from which the basis bill is taken.
- **Minimum history**: the billing periods of history the location must have for the bill basis to be used; with less history the new-service estimate applies.
- **New-service flat estimate** and **estimate per kVA**: with short history, the higher of the flat estimate and the per-kVA figure multiplied by the kVA of installed transformer capacity.
- **Minimum deposit**: the floor on one assessment.
- **Maximum deposit**: the ceiling on all deposits held or billed on one service account together.
- **Rounding increment**: the computed deposit is rounded up to the next multiple of this amount.

## Schedule

| Tier | Basis bill | Multiple | Lookback (billing periods) | Minimum history (billing periods) | Flat estimate | Estimate per kVA | Minimum deposit | Maximum deposit | Rounding increment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | average bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $200.00 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $600.00 | $5.00 |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | highest bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $300.00 | $0.00 | $150.00 | $900.00 | $5.00 |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | average bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $150.00 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $400.00 | $5.00 |
| Farm Service Deposit | average bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $250.00 | $0.00 | $150.00 | $900.00 | $5.00 |
| General Service Deposit | average bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $300.00 | $4.50 | $150.00 | $3000.00 | $10.00 |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | highest bill | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | $1500.00 | $9.00 | $500.00 | $50000.00 | $100.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- On the four tiers whose estimate per kVA is $0.00, the per-kVA product is always nil, so the higher of the two estimates is the flat estimate.
- Worked illustration (hypothetical): a General Service Deposit location with too little history and a 75 kVA transformer has a per-kVA product of $337.50, which is higher than the $300.00 flat estimate, so $337.50 is the estimate before rounding; rounded up to the next multiple of $10.00 it becomes $340.00.
- The ceiling applies to the deposits of one service account taken together, not to each assessment separately.
